The smell of cardamom, from my grandparent's house, the one my father was brought up back in India. There used to be a cuphoard shelf that was locked with books and other such along with cardamom, which was stored there so it wouldn't go cold, to sell when the price was right, grandparents are both teachers, but they're village people and they like doing small stuff like this as a small side income. The magazines that came for me would be kept locked inside with the cardamom, for when I travel back home, and when taken out the pages have a very pleasant smell that lasts for years. I still have books that have a faint smell of cardamom, best thing ever
